title: Develop a probability model from observed frequencies

sections.skill: Develop a probability model from observed frequencies

questions.skill: Develop a probability model from observed frequencies
questions.prompt: A bottle cap is tossed 80 times. It lands top-up 52 times. Estimate the probability that it lands top-up.
questions.prompt_markup:
A bottle cap is tossed 80 times. It lands top-up 52 times.
Estimate the probability that it lands top-up.

questions.skill: Develop a probability model from observed frequencies
questions.prompt: A spinner with three unequal sections is spun 200 times: red 90 times, blue 70 times, and green 40 times. Write an estimated probability for each color.
questions.prompt_markup:
A spinner with three unequal sections is spun 200 times: red 90 times, blue 70 times, and green 40 times.
Write an estimated probability for each color.
questions.grading_note: Equivalent fractions or percents are also correct.

questions.skill: Develop a probability model from observed frequencies
questions.prompt: A spinner landed on red 90 times, blue 70 times, and green 40 times in 200 spins. Which is the best prediction for 1,000 spins?
questions.prompt_markup:
A spinner landed on red 90 times, blue 70 times, and green 40 times in 200 spins.

sections.skill: Construct a two-way table from survey counts

questions.skill: Construct a two-way table from survey counts
questions.prompt: 50 students were surveyed. 30 have a phone. 18 of the students with a phone also have a tablet. 8 of the students without a phone have a tablet. Complete the two-way table.
questions.prompt_markup:
50 students were surveyed. 30 have a phone. 18 of the students with a phone also have a tablet. 8 of the students without a phone have a tablet.
Complete the two-way table.
questions.correct_answer: Phone: 18 tablet, 12 no tablet, 30 total. No phone: 8 tablet, 12 no tablet, 20 total. Totals: 26 tablet, 24 no tablet, 50 in all.

figure.description: Table.  | Tablet | No tablet | Total / Phone |            |            |            / No phone |            |            |            / Total |            |            |           .
